mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_logs ( user_id, feature_code, request_prompt, response_text, model_name, success_yn, error_message ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{featureCode}, #{requestPrompt}, #{responseText}, #{modelName}, #{successYn}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, u.name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.school_name, s.grade_level, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.class_name, ', ' ORDER BY c.class_name) AS class_names FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY s.student_id, u.name, s.student_no, s.school_name, s.grade_level

SELECT ar.status_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} AND TO_CHAR(ar.attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY ar.status_code ORDER BY ar.status_code

SELECT e.exam_name, e.subject, e.exam_date, e.total_score, c.class_name, g.score, g.rank_no, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grades gr WHERE gr.exam_id = g.exam_id ) AS rank_total, g.comment FROM grades g JOIN exams e ON e.exam_id = g.exam_id JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id WHERE g.student_id = #{studentId} AND TO_CHAR(e.exam_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.exam_id

SELECT f.billing_month, f.fee_amount, f.discount_amount, f.fee_amount - f.discount_amount AS billable_amount, f.due_date, f.status_code, f.description FROM fees f WHERE f.student_id = #{studentId} AND f.billing_month = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY f.due_date, f.fee_id

SELECT cr.counseling_date, cr.counseling_type, cr.visibility_code, cr.content, tu.name AS teacher_name, cu.name AS created_by_name FROM counseling_records cr LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = cr.created_by WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND TO_CHAR(cr.counseling_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY cr.counseling_date, cr.counseling_id

SELECT cr.counseling_id, cr.counseling_date, cr.counseling_type, cr.visibility_code, cr.content, su.name AS student_name, pu.name AS parent_name, tu.name AS teacher_name, cu.name AS created_by_name FROM counseling_records cr JOIN students s ON s.student_id = cr.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = cr.parent_id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = cr.created_by WHERE cr.counseling_id = #{counselingId}

SELECT cr.counseling_id, cr.counseling_date, cr.counseling_type, cr.visibility_code, LEFT(REPLACE(cr.content, CHR(10), ' '), 120) AS content_preview, su.name AS student_name, pu.name AS parent_name, tu.name AS teacher_name, cls.class_names, cu.name AS created_by_name FROM counseling_records cr JOIN students s ON s.student_id = cr.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = cr.parent_id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.class_name, ', ' ORDER BY c.class_name) AS class_names FROM enrollments en JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = en.class_id WHERE en.student_id = cr.student_id AND en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ) cls ON true JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = cr.created_by
su.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
pu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
tu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM enrollments en_filter JOIN classes c_filter ON c_filter.class_id = en_filter.class_id WHERE en_filter.student_id = cr.student_id AND en_filter.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c_filter.class_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
cr.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
( su.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cls.class_names ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cr.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY cr.counseling_date DESC, cr.counseling_id DESC LIMIT 80

choose.when:
SELECT DISTINCT pu.name AS label, pu.name AS value FROM counseling_records cr JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = cr.parent_id JOIN users pu ON pu.user_id = p.user_id WHERE pu.name IS NOT NULL
AND pu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY label LIMIT 30

SELECT DISTINCT tu.name AS label, tu.name AS value FROM counseling_records cr JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = cr.teacher_id JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id WHERE tu.name IS NOT NULL
AND tu.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY label LIMIT 30

SELECT DISTINCT c.class_name AS label, c.class_name AS value FROM counseling_records cr JOIN enrollments en ON en.student_id = cr.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = en.class_id WHERE en.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
AND c.class_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY label LIMIT 30
choose.otherwise:
SELECT DISTINCT su.name AS label, su.name AS value FROM counseling_records cr JOIN students s ON s.student_id = cr.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id WHERE su.name IS NOT NULL
AND su.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY label LIMIT 30

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, u.name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.school_name, s.grade_level FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name, s.student_id
